scope: filter-hz 1.2.1: a locked FRQ's box is 33 pixels, wide enough for kHz values.
finding: Stock OS 1.74 draws a locked value's inverted box itself, at a fixed width: the knob value routine (0x40037a56) centres the value text on the knob and, in the label row, inverts x-13..x+13, 27 pixels, whatever the text. Filter Hz 1.2.0 writes values of 1 kHz or more as 28 to 31 pixels ('1.05kHz' .. '21.1kHz'), so the text stuck out of the box; values under 1 kHz are at most 25 pixels and fit. Read in the firmware code; addresses only.
change: filter_hz_box replaces the routine's five pushes of the rectangle (0x40037bea, 20 bytes). For FRQ (parameter 47, read from the routine's argument) it pushes x-16..x+16, 33 pixels, for every value: FRQ text is at most 31 pixels and centred on x. For every other parameter it pushes stock's x-13..x+13.

builds.label: FH00
builds.content: Modwerk base package 1c14b6b0 + Filter Hz 1.2.0 on stock OS 1.74

method: Cold boot, NO four times, FLTR on track BD, snapshot. Then the parameter set by its CC on channel 1; GRID RECORDING, hold trig 1 and nudge the knob once, which locks the shown value; frame taken with the trig held. Unlocked: one nudge with no trig held.
results: FRQ locked at every value 0 to 127: the box is x 0..32 every time; the text has at least one pixel of box on each side and no pixel outside it. 1.2.0 at 75, 76, 88, 100, 116, 126 and 127: 2 to 11 text pixels outside stock's box.
FRQ locked at Hz values (0 to 74): the same 33-pixel box, so these frames differ from 1.2.0's, whose box was 27 pixels.
Unlocked FRQ at 0, 60, 75 and 127, and locked RES (0, 64, 127), TYP (3), ENV (0, 64, 127), ATK (64) and DEC (64): identical to 1.2.0.
limitations: Other pages' locked values were not compared; the changed code returns stock's rectangle for any parameter but FRQ.
